title: Inception
description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets. He is offered a chance to erase his criminal past by performing the impossible task of planting an idea into someone's mind.

title: Interstellar
description: Earth is becoming uninhabitable, so a group of astronauts travels through a wormhole to find a new home for humanity.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces his greatest enemy, the Joker, whose chaos pushes Gotham City to the edge and tests Batman's sense of justice.

title: Avatar
description: A former Marine travels to Pandora, where he becomes part of the Na'vi people and must choose between protecting them or following military orders.
